purpose: Make role/mode transitions explicit so conversation context, identity provenance, task ownership, owner-scope liveness, discovery blindness, tool visibility, and role authority are merged selectively rather than inherited implicitly.

merge_semantics.PRESERVE: state is retained and remains usable under the destination role when that role independently has authority to use it
merge_semantics.PRESERVE_AS_PROVENANCE_ONLY: state remains recorded but grants no destination-role authority
merge_semantics.SUSPEND: state remains durable but destination role may not act through it until an authorized role resumes
merge_semantics.CLEAR_AUTHORITY: destination role receives none of the source role's permission even if context/identity remains
merge_semantics.DOWNGRADE_BLINDNESS: CLEAN becomes ANCHOR_EXPOSED and cannot be upgraded back in the same exposed context
merge_semantics.RECOMPUTE: destination role must resolve the state again from its canonical authority
merge_semantics.ALLOCATE_OR_RESOLVE: destination research role resolves/preserves an appropriate visible role identity under research_identity_state_machine.json
merge_semantics.DO_NOT_REFRESH_OWNER_LIVENESS: destination-role conversation messages are not exact task-owner liveness evidence; the last task/claim-scoped activity clock continues to age

universal_transition_rules.execution_identity_handle: PRESERVE_AS_PROVENANCE_ONLY unless the destination role identity rules explicitly permit same-conversation reuse; visible label/scope must always match the active destination role
universal_transition_rules.role_authority: CLEAR_AUTHORITY then independently activate destination authority
universal_transition_rules.task_owner_claim: PRESERVE_AS_PROVENANCE_ONLY; role switch alone never releases, renews, transfers, or duplicates the winning CLAIM
universal_transition_rules.owner_scope_liveness: Only exact claim-bound TASK_RESEARCH_RESPONSE or DURABLE_EXECUTION_PROGRESS may refresh it; messages under another role/mode do not
universal_transition_rules.working_truth: PRESERVE_AS_TASK_PROVENANCE_ONLY; usable only when destination is authorized TASK_RESEARCH under the exact task scope
universal_transition_rules.blindness: monotone: once current-result/agenda/tool-catalog exposure relevant to discovery occurred, same-context FREE cannot claim CLEAN

CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE->TASK_RESEARCH.source_control_authority: CLEAR_AUTHORITY as research authority; control maintenance grants none
CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE->TASK_RESEARCH.task_claim: RECOMPUTE canonical owner scope; adopt same valid CLAIM only when runtime rules authorize adoption
CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE->TASK_RESEARCH.owner_scope_liveness: RECOMPUTE from exact current claim; prior control-plane messages are not task liveness evidence
CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE->TASK_RESEARCH.tool_visibility: TASK_RESEARCH policy after task semantics are understood
CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE->TASK_RESEARCH.blindness: not applicable unless later transitioning to FREE
forbidden: treating prior control inspection as research evidence
using control-mode access as Driver/Steward authority

CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE->RESEARCH_DRIV.activation: explicit Driver activation required in current conversation
CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE->RESEARCH_DRIV.owner_scope_liveness: DO_NOT_REFRESH_OWNER_LIVENESS for any suspended Researcher CLAIM
forbidden: inferring Driver authority from having maintained the control plane

CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE->FOUNDATION_ST.owner_scope_liveness: DO_NOT_REFRESH_OWNER_LIVENESS for any suspended Researcher CLAIM
forbidden: inferring Steward authority from control-plane maintenance

CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE->FREE_AXIOM_DI.blindness: ANCHOR_EXPOSED if the control session has inspected current agenda/results/tool vocabulary; use a fresh clean conversation for CLEAN
CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE->FREE_AXIOM_DI.tool_visibility: FREE Phase A hidden project-tool catalog
forbidden: claiming CLEAN blindness after current-project control/agenda exposure

TASK_RESEARCH->CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE.identity: PRESERVE_AS_PROVENANCE_ONLY; no research-role footer while only control mode is active
TASK_RESEARCH->CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE.task_claim: PRESERVE_AS_PROVENANCE_ONLY; do not release or renew merely because role changed
TASK_RESEARCH->CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE.owner_scope_liveness: DO_NOT_REFRESH_OWNER_LIVENESS; control-plane replies do not keep the task active; stale adoption is measured from last exact task/claim activity
forbidden: continuing theorem work while claiming to be control-only
using task CLAIM as control-mode theorem authority
counting control-plane replies as TASK_RESEARCH heartbeat

RESEARCH_DRIVER->CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENAN.identity: PRESERVE_AS_PROVENANCE_ONLY; Driver-ID no longer grants active Driver role
RESEARCH_DRIVER->CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENAN.owner_scope_liveness: DO_NOT_REFRESH_OWNER_LIVENESS for any suspended Researcher CLAIM
forbidden: continuing portfolio verdict/review authority under control-only mode

FOUNDATION_STEWARD->CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTE.identity: PRESERVE_AS_PROVENANCE_ONLY; Steward-ID no longer grants active Steward role
FOUNDATION_STEWARD->CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTE.owner_scope_liveness: DO_NOT_REFRESH_OWNER_LIVENESS for any suspended Researcher CLAIM
forbidden: continuing Foundation canonicalization under control-only mode

FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY->CONTROL_PLANE_MAIN.owner_scope_liveness: DO_NOT_REFRESH_OWNER_LIVENESS for any unrelated/suspended TASK CLAIM
FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY->CONTROL_PLANE_MAIN.blindness: if control inspection opens withheld current context before candidate freeze, downgrade to ANCHOR_EXPOSED
forbidden: returning to same-context FREE and claiming CLEAN after withheld context was exposed

TASK_RESEARCH->FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY.identity: same-conversation handle may persist under identity state machine, visible scope becomes FREE
TASK_RESEARCH->FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY.owner_scope_liveness: DO_NOT_REFRESH_OWNER_LIVENESS; FREE responses do not keep suspended task claim active
TASK_RESEARCH->FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY.blindness: DOWNGRADE_BLINDNESS to ANCHOR_EXPOSED in same conversation
TASK_RESEARCH->FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY.tool_visibility: FREE Phase A hides further project-tool/current-result reads, but prior exposure cannot be unread
TASK_RESEARCH->FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY.preferred: fresh conversation for CLEAN free discovery

RESEARCH_DRIVER->FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY.identity: resolve Researcher-ID/free scope under identity rules
RESEARCH_DRIVER->FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY.blindness: DOWNGRADE_BLINDNESS to ANCHOR_EXPOSED in same conversation
RESEARCH_DRIVER->FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY.preferred: fresh conversation for CLEAN free discovery

FOUNDATION_STEWARD->FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY.identity: resolve Researcher-ID/free scope under identity rules
FOUNDATION_STEWARD->FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY.blindness: DOWNGRADE_BLINDNESS to ANCHOR_EXPOSED in same conversation
FOUNDATION_STEWARD->FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY.preferred: fresh conversation for CLEAN free discovery

FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY->TASK_RESEARCH.identity: same-conversation Researcher-ID may persist under identity rules; visible scope becomes active task
FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY->TASK_RESEARCH.blindness: record prior FREE blindness provenance; TASK may now load task/current context
FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY->TASK_RESEARCH.owner_scope_liveness: RECOMPUTE from exact active claim; FREE messages are not inherited as task liveness evidence
FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY->TASK_RESEARCH.tool_visibility: TASK policy; if candidate/no-go was frozen, run required post-freeze coverage/reuse resolution
forbidden: treating task publication as Working Truth activation

TASK_RESEARCH->RESEARCH_DRIVER.identity: visible role switches to Driver-ID under identity rules
TASK_RESEARCH->RESEARCH_DRIVER.task_claim: PRESERVE_AS_PROVENANCE_ONLY; Driver role does not execute research merely because the same conversation owns a Researcher CLAIM
TASK_RESEARCH->RESEARCH_DRIVER.owner_scope_liveness: DO_NOT_REFRESH_OWNER_LIVENESS; Driver replies do not keep suspended TASK claim active
TASK_RESEARCH->RESEARCH_DRIVER.working_truth: task provenance preserved; Driver may separately freeze/supersede only under Driver authority

RESEARCH_DRIVER->TASK_RESEARCH.driver_authority: CLEAR_AUTHORITY once Driver role is left
RESEARCH_DRIVER->TASK_RESEARCH.task_claim: RECOMPUTE; reuse/adopt existing claim only through runtime rules
RESEARCH_DRIVER->TASK_RESEARCH.owner_scope_liveness: RECOMPUTE from exact active claim; prior Driver replies are not task liveness evidence
RESEARCH_DRIVER->TASK_RESEARCH.working_truth: usable only if exact task scope currently grants it

FOUNDATION_STEWARD->TASK_RESEARCH.steward_authority: CLEAR_AUTHORITY once Steward role is left
FOUNDATION_STEWARD->TASK_RESEARCH.owner_scope_liveness: RECOMPUTE from exact active claim; prior Steward replies are not task liveness evidence
forbidden: treating Steward publisher provenance as Researcher execution ownership

TASK_RESEARCH->FOUNDATION_STEWARD.identity: visible role switches to Steward-ID under identity rules
TASK_RESEARCH->FOUNDATION_STEWARD.owner_scope_liveness: DO_NOT_REFRESH_OWNER_LIVENESS; Steward replies do not keep suspended TASK claim active
forbidden: using a Researcher CLAIM as Foundation canonicalization authority
